items.title: PHP紧急修复两项严重漏洞，官方敦促用户立即升级  现在，此时此刻 PHP 团队发布安全更新，修复两项可能让攻击者无需登录即可远程执行代码的严重漏洞。
items.title_zh: PHP 紧急发布补丁，修复两个 CVSS 9.2 的未授权远程代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: PHP ships emergency patches for two critical pre-auth RCE flaws (CVSS 9.2)
items.summary: PHP released emergency security updates for two pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerabilities rated CVSS 9.2, urging immediate upgrades to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 across all web-request-handling deployments.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed

items.title_en: Moonshot AI ships Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed serving variant
items.summary: Moonshot AI announces Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed variant, prompting heavy HN discussion on benchmarks, pricing, rate limits, and model behavior.

items.title: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
items.title_zh: Calif 博客宣称成功攻破 iPhone，引发越狱与 AI 访问权限之争
items.title_en: Calif blog claims a successful iPhone hack, igniting jailbreak and AI-access debate
items.summary: A blog post describing a successful effort to hack an iPhone, sparking debate on jailbreaking, Lockdown mode's real-world efficacy, and the gated access frontier labs grant to security researchers.
